==Notes==
*This stance ends before your next successful hit, so attack skills affected by stances such as [[Standing Slash]] or [[Barbarous Slice]] will not consider you in a stance if they hit.

==Trivia==
*The [[Warrior]] displayed on the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[Sunspear armor]] and is also seen on the skill icons of [[Lion's Comfort]], [[Headbutt]] and [[Flail]].
